personality_one_liner: A premium, breathable, and visual-first storefront that feels like a modern natural wellness magazine.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding. Group related elements tightly, but keep generous whitespace between major sections to let the photography breathe.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar
Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use glass for floating action buttons or sticky 'Add to Cart' zones
dont's: Do not use glass on product cards or list rows

screens.name: Splash & Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the premium, natural ethos of SUNSU with full-bleed imagery.
screens.layout: Full-bleed imagery of natural ingredients with a top-to-bottom transparent-to-dark scrim. Text and primary CTA anchored safely at the bottom third.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A digital magazine-style storefront prioritizing visual discovery and curated collections.

states.loading: Skeleton blocks matching the hero and grid layout
states.error: Failed to load feed. Retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable feed: starts with a full-width hero promo carousel. Followed by a horizontally scrolling 'Categories' row (circular or rounded-rect imagery). Next, a 2-column 'Best Sellers' grid, 'Shop by Need' banner, and Trust/Reviews section. Search bar sticky at top.

screens.name: Shop (PLP)
screens.purpose: Browse products efficiently with accessible filtering and clear item cards.

states.empty: No products match the selected filters. 'Clear Filters' CTA.
states.error: Unable to load products. Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky chip-based filter row at the top below a clean header. 2-column grid of white cards on the off-white background. Cards show image (60% height), title, price, MRP strikethrough, discount tag (in brandSecondary), and a 'Quick Add' button.

screens.name: Product Details (PDP)
screens.purpose: Act as the primary decision-making hub, minimizing cognitive load while providing rich detail.

states.error: Unable to load product info. Retry button.

screens.layout: Fold 1: Edge-to-edge high-quality image carousel. Below image: Title, Rating, Price block, Variant chips (size/weight). Sticky 'Add to Cart' container at the very bottom (glass background). Lower sections: Expandable accordions for Ingredients, Nutrition, Reviews.

screens.name: Cart & Checkout
screens.purpose: Frictionless review and payment flow with clear cost breakdowns.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty basket + 'Start Shopping' CTA.
states.error: Error applying coupon or fetching shipping. Toast or inline alert.

screens.layout: List of items with quantity controls. Clean breakdown of subtotal, shipping, and discount. Sticky primary CTA 'Proceed to Checkout' at the bottom.

screens.name: Account & Orders
screens.purpose: Manage profile, addresses, and track order status.

states.error: Unable to fetch account details. Retry button.

screens.layout: Clean list format (iOS settings style) for account options. Order tracking uses a vertical timeline layout with clear status indicators.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the user's palette: Background #F7F5F0, Primary green #15803D, Secondary #16A34A, text #172017, Cards #FFFFFF.
Use a warm fruit-inspired accent (#E65100 - vibrant orange) sparingly for discounts, badges, or secondary CTAs to offset the green and add warmth.
Typography: Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' globally. It provides the requested 'Inter or better' modern, highly readable feel but with slightly more warmth and geometric structure.
Cards and Containers: Use 'md' (12px) radius. Avoid excessive pill shapes per user instruction. Stick to structural, clean rectangles with soft corners.
Ensure the 'Product Details (PDP)' screen has a sticky 'Add to Cart' container at the bottom over scrolling content, utilizing a glass background for premium feel.
For the Home screen, treat it like an editorial layout. Do not cram too many products into one row. Use ample spacing (`xl` to `2xl`) between sections.
Do NOT use indigo, purple, or blue anywhere in the app. If a system component defaults to blue, override it to `brandPrimary` (#15803D) or `onSurface`.
Order Tracking: Implement a clear, step-by-step vertical timeline for the order tracking screen.
All full-bleed images MUST have a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee text contrast.
